title: Finite ordered Cech augmentation of a flasque sheaf
statement: Let X be a scheme and M an O_X-module sheaf whose underlying abelian sheaf is flasque [def-sc-zariski-flasque]. Let U:Fin r → Opens(X) be a finite open cover, allowing the empty cover of an empty space. For the ordered Cech functor L [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex], the restriction map from the degree-zero single complex of Gamma(X,M) to L(M) is a quasi-isomorphism. More precisely there is a cochain map f with f in degree zero equal to the single-complex evaluation isomorphism followed by alternatingCechZero U M, and f is a quasi-isomorphism. The category of module sheaves is [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

proof.text: Identify the full site Cech section complex with the topological-space Cech complex by the canonical identification of finite intersections. The source-library theorem TopCat.Sheaf.exactAt_cechComplex_of_isFlasque gives exactness in every positive degree.
The restriction map from full Cech cochains to increasing-tuple cochains is a homotopy equivalence. Transport positive exactness across its homology isomorphism.

In degree zero, compatible tuples glue uniquely by the sheaf condition, including the empty cover. In negative degrees both complexes vanish. Extend the degree-zero restriction to a single-complex map and use the degreewise quasi-isomorphism criterion. Reuse the proved alternatingRow_zero_d, alternatingRow_glue and alternatingRow_mono helpers of Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.InjectiveAlternatingCechRowAugmentation; do not reproduce their proofs.
